title: Voxel engine rough draft
author: Significant-Neck-520
selftext:
So, my previous attempts at coding something I would try to understand the code, see what the AI was doing, trying to direct the architecture. This one I'm giving up understanding how any of this works, gemini and later claude setup a whole system using unity jobs system, and then claude wrote the shaders.

Still in early work, no saving in disk for instance, but I'm happy with the results so far. Actually, not happy, hooked is a better word, for requesting new features and seeing them come to life.
